Keyframe Reducer

Reduce dense animation curves to make motion capture cleanup and manual corrections easier.

Blender 5.2PythonAnimation · v1.1.1

Download

Download add-on · v1.1.1 (.zip)

Free · GPL-3.0-or-later · Python source included. Install this ZIP directly in Blender without extracting it. English interface; English and French guides included in the ZIP.

The task

Working with Brekel and Kinect v2 capture and Mixamo animations led me to dense curves that were cumbersome to edit in Blender. I wanted a reduction workflow closer to what I use in Cinema 4D, with control over the sections being simplified.

The approach

I developed this add-on with AI assistance around a protected source Action, adjustable tolerances and before/after comparison. The Selected Keys mode grew out of a practical need: simplify one passage while preserving the surrounding animation.

In use

The tool lets me compare a reduced copy, adjust the result from the original and keep it for manual editing. The current version was checked in Blender 5.2.1 LTS, including selected sections of a Mixamo animation and updating an already enabled add-on.

Controls

  • Reduce an Entire Action or only Selected Keys in the Graph Editor.
  • Adjust Strength and separate position, rotation and scale tolerances.
  • Compare Original / Reduced and recalculate from the protected source.
  • Preserve unselected keys, gaps and selection boundaries.
  • Reduce New Selection to continue on another passage, then Keep Copy for Editing.

Workflow

  1. Download the ZIP above. In Blender, open Edit → Preferences → Add-ons → Install from Disk and select the ZIP without extracting it.
  2. Select the armature and its active Action. For an NLA montage, bake the motion to an Action first.
  3. Open the Graph Editor, press N and choose Key Reducer. Select Entire Action, or select key points and choose Scope → Selected Keys.
  4. Click Reduce on a Copy, compare Original / Reduced, then adjust Strength and use Recalculate from Source if needed.
  5. For quaternion rotation, select W, X, Y and Z at matching times. Each selected run needs at least three consecutive keys.
  6. Click Keep Copy for Editing before correcting keys manually. To simplify another passage first, show Reduced and use Reduce New Selection.

Scope & limitations

Processes the active Action, not the NLA stack. Error checks sample local transforms; they do not lock feet in world space or automatically remove capture jitter. Quaternion components must be selected together. Selected Keys excludes hidden curves. Locked curves and unsupported channels are preserved.

Requires Blender 5.2 or later. Checked on Windows in Blender 5.2.1 LTS. English interface; guides in English and French. No external dependencies.
